metadata.description: A personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills — install them yourself or share with others.

plugins.name: k1-workpaper-builder
plugins.description: Extract Schedule K-1 (Form 1065 & 1120-S) tax packages into a verified, multi-sheet Excel workpaper: every Part III box, per-code statement detail, capital accounts, liabilities, tie-out checks, and a state income/withholding/composite summary.

plugins.name: 401k-wire-transfer-testing
plugins.description: 401(k) plan audit WP 5220 wire transfer / timely remittance testing: match payroll register 401(k), Roth, loan and employer match withholdings to the recordkeeper contribution report for every check date, compute business days to funding and over/(under) funding. Any payroll provider, any recordkeeper. Provides the /5220 command.
